final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT a.link_to_member, m.position, COUNT(*) as count_records FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member GROUP BY a.link_to_member, m.position), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(count_records) as total_count FROM step1) SELECT step1.link_to_member, step1.position, step1.count_records, CAST(step1.count_records AS REAL) / step2.total_count as ratio FROM step1, step2 ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
